What you’ll do: 

Are you ready to take a senior engineering role in shaping mission-critical planning solutions at the heart of the world’s leading enterprise software company? This is an opportunity to contribute to SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with a focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). Together, these solutions help customers plan complex supply chains, optimize service levels, production resources, material availability, and operational execution across industries. 

You will work on business-critical planning capabilities used by customers with large service parts, manufacturing, warehouse, dealer, and distribution networks. Our roadmap includes modern SAP Fiori user experiences, advanced planning algorithms, forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, analytics, integration with SAP S/4HANA capabilities such as aATP, and the next wave of AI-assisted planning, optimization, and navigation. 

As a Senior Developer in our SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning team, you will: 

- Own the design, implementation, testing, and delivery of complex features across eSPP and PP/DS, with responsibility for quality, maintainability, performance, and long-term product standard compliance. 
- Apply your strong C++ background to analyze and evolve planning and optimization-related components, while also working with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, and SAP S/4HANA integration patterns. 
- Contribute to capabilities for service parts planning, production planning, detailed scheduling, forecasting, inventory planning, stocking and destocking decisions, simulation, mass maintenance, analytics, and integration with adjacent SAP solutions. 
- Drive technical concepts, architectural improvements, refactoring, automated tests, code reviews, root-cause analysis, and defect prevention for mission-critical private cloud products. 
- Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, quality engineers, product management, and development colleagues across locations to translate customer and roadmap requirements into reliable, scalable, and user-oriented solutions. 
- Act as a technical role model for less experienced developers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs and code, and helping the team continuously improve engineering practices. 
- Help shape the next generation of planning capabilities, including AI-assisted planning experiences, Joule-based contextual assistance, embedded analytics, and modern SAP Fiori user experiences. 
 
What you bring: 
- A good to excellent university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Natural Sciences, or a related field. 
- Several years of professional software development experience, ideally in enterprise software, planning, optimization, logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing-related domains. 
- A strong C++ background is required, including solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, debugging, performance analysis, and maintainable code design. 
- Experience with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, or SAP S/4HANA architecture is a strong plus; willingness to broaden your expertise across the SAP technology stack is expected. 
- Experience or strong interest in PP/DS, eSPP, Production Planning, Materials Management, service parts planning, detailed scheduling, or related supply chain planning processes. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex planning algorithms, business processes, and customer scenarios. 
- A senior mindset: ownership, technical leadership, high quality standards, clear communication, constructive collaboration, and the ability to guide others while remaining hands-on. 
- Fluent communication skills in English; German language skills are beneficial. 

Tech & topics you will work with 

- You will deepen and apply your expertise in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). 
- You will work across C++, ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, SAP S/4HANA integration, analytics, and development practices used in mission-critical private cloud products. 
- You will contribute to planning and optimization capabilities, including forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, advanced analytics, AI-assisted planning, enterprise search, Joule-based assistance, and guided planning experiences. 
 
Meet the team: 

This senior role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership in strategic SAP planning solutions that help customers run complex after-sales, manufacturing, and supply chain planning processes more efficiently, transparently, and intelligently. You will contribute to the evolution of both eSPP and PP/DS while growing as a recognized expert in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning.

What You'll DoBackend engineering at Legal Hero means full ownership. You'll design and run services in our Kotlin/Java stack with Micronaut on AWS, wire LLM capabilities reliably into product flows, harden production systems, and actively shape our testing, deployment, and observability practice — together with a team that takes the craft seriously.
• Design and own scalable backend services from first commit to production — APIs, data models, versioning, SLOs, and on-call included
• Build and evolve high-performance, secure infrastructure that handles real load — not just greenfield, but messy reality
• Wire LLM-powered capabilities reliably into product flows: suggestion APIs, RAG-backed endpoints, agent tool calls — you make AI actually land in production
• Work closely with frontend, product, and AI teams — your APIs are their foundation, so you design them to last
• Make the hard tradeoffs: schema migrations, breaking changes, dependency upgrades — with judgment, not just best practices
• Raise the quality bar through automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and push for architectural improvements that matter
• Lead incident investigations on your own services, write the postmortem, and escalate only once you have answers

What you bring
• 6+ years in backend engineering, including 2+ years at senior level
• Strong proficiency in Kotlin or Java — JVM idioms feel like home
• Relational databases (MySQL or similar) and at least one public cloud in production, AWS preferred
• Distributed systems thinking as a reflex: idempotency, retries, eventual consistency, observability
• Business fluent English; German at B1 or a clear commitment to get there within 12 months

Nice to have — and what you'll pick up here:
• Micronaut, Kubernetes, AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM, the official Claude Agent SDK, MCP-based architecture
• Experience with regulated data environments (GDPR, BaFin, §203 StGB)

• Office-first company: Hybrid setup with 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, offering flexibility in how you structure your work
• Modern, air-conditioned office with plenty of natural daylight
• Central location between Gleisdreieck and Potsdamer Platz with excellent public transport access
• Spacious rooftop terrace with stunning views over Berlin

Benefits
• Full coverage of a Germany-wide public transport ticket
• Dog-friendly office – we’re happy to welcome four-legged team members
• Corporate benefits platform with attractive offers and discounts across many brands
• Company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution – we invest in your future
• Regular company and team events to strengthen collaboration and team spirit
• After-work fun: Nintendo Switch, PS5, darts, and table football
• Free drinks, fresh fruit, and muesli available at all times

Company Culture & Collaboration
• Agile and modern mindset with open communication – every voice is heard
• Meaningful areas of responsibility with a strong focus on practical, real-world legal solutions
• The opportunity to actively shape our journey and contribute from day one

Fast Application Process

Legalhero was founded in 2017 and has helped hundreds of thousands of policyholders to date. Our approximately 90 colleagues are based in Berlin, near the Gleisdreieck.

The life sciences increasingly depend on advanced services offered by core facilities, synchrotrons, data services and other research infrastructures, creating a need for highly-skilled professionals who can operate, improve and expand these scientific services.

EMBL’s ARISE2 programme offers over 20 fully funded, three-year postdoctoral fellowships for researchers with STEM backgrounds who are interested in advancing their careers in research infrastructures in academia or industry. ARISE2 fellows will:

Develop a method or development within EMBL’s areas of expertise, with potential for broader service application
Receive structured training in the operation and management of research infrastructures, including service provision, project and staff management, innovation, science policy, FAIR principals and AI.
Build professional networks through secondment and job shadowing at EMBL and ARISE2 partner organisations

ARISE2 projects should align with EMBL’s research areas-such as genomics, structural biology, imaging, cell and tissue biology, environmental research, and translational applications-while contributing to the development of services that support the wider life science community.

You may develop projects in fields including:

Data and computational science: Bioinformatics, AI/ML, computational modelling, software engineering, data management, data science.

Imaging and optical engineering: Imaging and image analysis, optical engineering, detector development, microscopy, X-ray optics

Structural Biology and Mechanical Engineering: Automation, high-precision mechanics, microfluidics, robotics, X-ray crystallography

Biotechnology: (Bio)chemical engineering, chemistry or chemical biology, omics technologies.

A Ph.D. at the time of the call deadline (September 30, 2026). Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis but who have not yet been formally awarded the degree are eligible to apply.
A university degree in a relevant STEM discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics)
Experience in technology development - experience can be from academia and/or industry and should be relevant to the research fields of our groups and teams that are participating in the programme.
Strong research potential that can be illustrated by a diverse set of research outputs (e.g., publications, software, data sets, patents, technical documentation, contribution to technology development or other innovative research etc.)
The ability to work independently and in a collaborative settings
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
Good organisational and time-management skills

You might also have

Experience in the improvement or development of methods, techniques or technology for service provision.

ARISE2 receives funding from HorizonEurope under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie action COFUND (grant agreement No 101178241).  EMBL is Europe’s flagship research laboratory for the life sciences - an intergovernmental organisation performing scientific research in disciplines including molecular biology, physics, chemistry and computer science. We are an international laboratory with more than 2000 employees from many nations, operating across six sites, in Heidelberg (HQ), Barcelona, Hinxton near Cambridge, Hamburg, Grenoble and Rome. One of our missions is to provide access to advanced technologies and engage in technology transfer activities.

EMBL is a curiosity-driven, community-oriented and international organisation. As an inclusive, equal opportunity employer, we believe that diversity enables us to collaborate more effectively and be innovative in our approaches. We are, therefore, committed to creating an inclusive and flexible culture - one where everyone can realise their full potential and make a positive contribution to our organisation. We operate by our values of: openness, inclusion, integrity, transparency, fairness.

Job Description

About Us

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas
- Be part of a stable, well-established organization with long-term career opportunities
- Strong collaboration with experienced CTMs and project teams
- Clear development pathways (e.g., Senior CRA, Lead CRA, CTM)
- Flexible working models that support work-life balance
- Permanent employment
- Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (32 hours/week) options available

About the Role

This position is for experienced Clinical Research Associates with 2+ years of independent monitoring experience. You will manage clinical trial sites across Germany, ensuring studies are conducted in compliance with the protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, and company SOPs.

You’ll work autonomously, partner closely with investigative sites, and collaborate with project teams to deliver high-quality, inspection-ready clinical trials.

What You’ll Do

- Perform site monitoring activities (on-site and remote) using a risk-based monitoring approach
- Ensure protocol, ICH-GCP, regulatory, and SOP compliance at investigator sites
- Conduct SDR, SDV, CRF review, and investigational product accountability
- Identify, document, escalate, and follow up on issues through resolution, applying root cause analysis and CAPA principles
- Maintain audit and inspection readiness at all assigned sites
- Build strong, collaborative relationships with investigators and site staff
- Document monitoring activities in timely, high-quality reports and follow-up letters
- Maintain ongoing communication with sites between visits to support issue resolution and data quality
- Ensure study systems (e.g., CTMS) are updated according to study conventions
- Provide trial status updates and metrics to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)
- Support study start-up, investigator identification, site initiation, and study close-out activities as assigned
- Participate in investigator meetings, audits, inspections, and project team meetings as required

Additional responsibilities may include supporting process improvement initiatives, mentoring activities, or project-specific tasks aligned with experience.

A Day in the Life

- Review site metrics and prioritize monitoring activities based on risk
- Conduct on-site or remote monitoring visits
- Partner with sites to resolve findings and improve processes
- Collaborate with CTMs and project teams to keep studies on track and inspection-ready
- Complete documentation, system updates, and administrative tasks

Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification
- Minimum 2+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience
- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations
- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals
- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams
- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)

Locations: Home-based or hybrid anywhere in Germany
FTE: Full-time (40 hrs/week) or Part-time 80% (32 hrs/week)
Contract: Permanent
Travel: Approximately 50–75% (study-dependent)

Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment. Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Purpose of your Job

Are you looking for a career in research & development of biopharmaceuticals or in general in the pharmaceutical industry?
Then join Coriolis Pharma and contribute with state-of-the-art capillary electrophoresis analytics to our formulations and lyophilization processes for biopharmaceutical drugs!
You will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team performing contract research and development for customers in the (bio) pharmaceutical industry worldwide.
You will be a vital part of our contract research organization – where you will support & learn from our scientific operations teams – to enable our clients in their journey of developing innovative drugs.

Your Responsibility

As Senior Scientist you are - together with the project team - responsible for the successful development and execution of capillary electrophoresis (CE) analysis for our customers worldwide.  

- Responsible—as subject matter expert—for supporting client project acquisition and execution with expertise to ensure high-quality services.
- Accountable for the electrophoretic characterization of biopharmaceutical molecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids) within client projects, including the de novo development of CE methods and the interpretation of data in context with other analytical approaches (such as LC-MS or LC-IEX).
- Maintain cutting-edge scientific knowledge in CE and related areas and drive CE innovation to meet evolving business needs, including new business areas and novel molecular modalities.
- Work cooperatively across Coriolis teams (e.g., business development, finance, technical support team) to ensure seamless collaboration with all operational groups during client project execution.
- Function as project leader for assigned client projects, overseeing project planning, method implementation, development, characterization, data evaluation, and reporting activities.

What you need to succeed

- University degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, (bio)chemistry, or a related field; a PhD related to separation sciences—ideally focused on CE applications / method development and associated areas—is preferred
- Minimum 5 years of industry experience (with PhD in a relevant field) or 9 years (without PhD) with in-depth knowledge of biopharmaceutical characterization by CE (CE-SDS, CZE, cIEF) using UV, PDA, LIF, or FLD detection
- Several years of hands-on experience with CE instruments from different vendors (e.g., Sciex, BioTechne/ProteinSimple, Agilent, etc.)
- Proven experience in developing, transferring, and troubleshooting CE (and associated) analytical methods in an industry setting, including both R&D and GMP environments
- Demonstrated project management skills, including resource management, multitasking, prioritization, and risk management
- Strong lateral leadership capabilities, with leading by example as a natural approach
- Hands-on, proactive mindset with openness to new ideas and tasks; a can-do attitude is essential
- Team-oriented personality with strong motivational and interpersonal skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Job responsibilities:

- This role requires working on-site exclusively, with no other working option available.
- To confirm with all site quality management systems and health & safety procedures (ISO17025:2017, ISO15189:2012, GCLP, Human Tissue Act (2004))
- Monitor project progress and quality, effectively communicate with relevant teams/departments; ensure projects are delivered within the turnaround time (TAT) and meet the quality requirement
- Formulate and update the production plans according to projection, arrange pipeline to ensure smooth operation, optimize NGS protocols and automation of laboratory procedures.
- Instruct team leaders to carry out production data summary and statistical analysis. Ensure all relevant information are documented and archived. Be responsible for conducting department's reports.
- Establish responsibilities for members by roles and technical levels, supervise them to perform their duties
- Other tasks assigned by the line manager.

Requirements:

- A Master's or advanced degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, genetics, biotechnology, or similar subject is required, with a minimum of three-year laboratory experience.
- Experiences in leading a team of 5-10 members (minimum). Strong teamwork ethic and the commitment to successfully deliver to tight deadlines are essential.
- High accuracy and attention to detail are a must for both laboratory and office-based work.
- A strong and open communication skills is essential.
- Fluent operating Microsoft Office software including Word, Excel and PowerPoints is essential.
- Experience of using Laboratory information management systems (LIMS) is advantageous.
- Experience in PCR, qPCR and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)-based analysis is advantageous.
- Very good knowledge of German and English language, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Chinese will be an added advantage.

Expertenkenntnisse: Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Versuchsplanung, Spektroskopie, Zellkulturforschung, Biomedizin, Gentechnologie, Biochemie, Molekulare Landwirtschaft, Tierversuche, Labortierkunde, Molekularbiologie, Medizinische Laborarbeiten, Qualitätsprüfung, Qualitätssicherung, Bakteriologische Untersuchungen, Gewebetypisierung, Mikrobiologie, Bakteriologie, Zellbiologie, Immunhämatologie, Serologie, Biologie, Biotechnologie, Bioverfahrenstechnik, Genetik, Immunhistochemie

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Flight Test Ground Station Germany Team Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/w/d)

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

As a Systems & Software Architect for the Flight Test Ground Station (FTGS)

- you will lead the end-to-end architectural lifecycle for a complex suite of flight test tools, including FTGS-Core, FIDA, and various Add-On tools.
- you will be responsible for defining and documenting comprehensive system requirements, balancing operational needs, technical constraints, and stringent regulatory requirements.
- your core mission involves developing and iterating robust architectures encompassing hardware, software, and network infrastructure.
- Utilizing established architectural patterns and best practices, you will design modular, scalable systems and produce high-quality design specifications, interface definitions, and technical documentation.
- You will play a decisive role in evaluating and selecting the technologies and components necessary for successful system implementation, ensuring seamless interoperability and compatibility between various subsystems and external interfaces.
- Beyond design, you will drive technical excellence by establishing development best practices, conducting detailed design studies, and overseeing validation and verification (V&V) strategies. You will actively support the system integration process and contribute to the creation of test strategies to validate architecture and performance.
- A key aspect of this role is cross-functional leadership within an Integrated Product Team (IPT). You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams—including software, hardware, test, and operations engineers—to resolve complex technical challenges.
- By leading "tiger teams" to address critical issues and facilitating continuous improvement through rigorous retrospectives, you will ensure long-term technical consistency.
- Furthermore, you will remain at the forefront of the industry by monitoring emerging technologies and trends in flight test and ground station systems, ensuring the FTGS toolchain remains cutting-edge and future-proof.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Education: Completed university degree (Master’s or Diploma) in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science
- Professional Experience: Several years of professional experience in system architecture or the design of complex technical systems, ideally within the Aerospace or Defense sectors.
- Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of Flight Test Ground Station systems, telemetry, data processing, and data analysis.
- Technical Proficiency:
- Advanced expertise in C++ development and software design patterns.
- Strong command of Linux environments and system administration.
- Proven experience with various software/hardware architectures and network protocols.
- Expertise in defining system requirements and creating architectural models (e.g., UML, SysML).
- Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop innovative, scalable solutions.
- Soft Skills: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to thrive in a multidisciplinary, international environment.
- Languages: Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
- Travel: Willingness to undertake occasional business travel.
- Preferred: Practical experience in flight test analysis is advantageous.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Job description

In order to provide high-fidelity training simulation, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Radar Simulation Specialist (d/f/m)

You will join a team of experienced engineers and subject matter experts to jointly define, implement and integrate complex simulation sub-systems in the domain of sensors and weapons. Our engineers are closely collaborating with other departments and external suppliers in order to provide solutions for high-fidelity trainings systems, with current focus on the Eurofighter pilot training simulation system PSTS.

You will serve as Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored simulation solutions for various radar systems, ranging from versatile, generic model to high-fidelity replicas of actual systems, such as the current Eurofighter MSCAN Radar, as well as future systems such as the Eurofighter ESCAN Radar. Based on your deep technical understanding of actual systems and your knowledge of electronic warfare, you will play a key role in the definition and development of optimal solutions to match simulation and/or training needs while respecting technical limitations of distributed real-time systems. As such, you are closely cooperating with various engineering teams, Chief Engineering and Operational Factors, and will act for Radar-related topics as point of contract for alignments and discussions with the Customer and external suppliers.

Major Role & Responsibilities

- Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored Radar simulation solutions
- Ensuring the technical expertise regarding current and future radar systems, such as Eurofighter MSCAN and ESCAN Radar
- Performance of Systems Engineering activities to ensure the viable technical radar solutions meeting the requirements and needs of the overall system.
- Technical coordination of external suppliers an alignment with internal stakeholders, such as Chief Engineering, development teams and Operational Factors
- Support of the integration and testing activities at the simulation devices in close collaboration of other subject matter experts
- Ensuring on-time, cost- and quality-compliant development as well as integration of a consistent and powerful radar simulation across all project phases.
- Technical support in the assessment and selection of suppliers

Specific & Technical Skills / Experience Required

- Expertise regarding - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar
- Eurofighter Training Needs and the current Pilot Synthetic Traning System (PSTS)
- Systems engineering (incl. tools such as DOORS)
- V-model based SW development process
- Extensive Experience in - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test
- Eurofighter Training Simulations Solutions (ASTA/PSTS)
- Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test
- Systems Engineering and V-model based SW development process, including active contribution in integration activities
- IT literate (MS Office applications)

General Skills / Experience Required

- Educated to degree level in computer science or engineering
- Good language skills in English, both written and spoken
- Strong communication skills with an ability to operate in a multi-cultural environment
- Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy while maintaining close, effective collaboration within a multi-disciplinary team.
- Capability to respond to changes in activities and priorities
- Experience in the alignment with and coordination of various stakeholders

FACILITIES MANAGER EUROPE (F/M/D)

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision?making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

As Facilities Manager Europe (f/m/d), you will support Clario's facilities across Europe with a focus on our office in Estenfeld, Germany.

WHAT WE OFFER

*
Competitive compensation.

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.

*
Hybrid work model, allowing for 1-2 days of remote work after the probation period.

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.

*
Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).

*
Engaging employee programs.

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Facilities Operations: Providing overall facilities support by ensuring the seamless delivery of facility operations, building management, structural measures, maintenance teams, housekeeping, reception, cafeteria operations, asset management, visitor management, and security & safety protocols. Clario's primary European facilities are situated in Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Switzerland, and Turkey.

*
Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.

*
Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.

*
Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.

*
Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.

*
Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.

*
External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.

*
Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.

*
Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.

*
Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.

*
Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.

*
Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.

*
Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.

*
Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.

*
Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.

*
Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.

*
Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.

*
Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.

*
Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.

*
Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.

*
Ability to influence others without direct authority.

*
Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.

*
A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.

*
Flexibility to travel to our European sites as needed, typically averaging two trips per year.

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
We are seeking an accomplished Scientist to advance our mission of delivering disease-modifying therapies to patients with liver cirrhosis.
As Principal Scientist, you will lead a team of lab scientists and take ownership of identifying and advancing novel therapeutic approaches — from target identification through to candidate selection. A deep understanding of liver physiology and expert knowledge of disease-relevant cellular and tissue models will set you up for success in this role.
Join us and drive innovative drug discovery projects within our Cardio-Renal-Metabolic Diseases Research Department, located at Boehringer Ingelheim's largest R&D site in Biberach an der Riss, Germany. You will work alongside talented colleagues, access cutting-edge technology, and help shape the future of liver disease therapy
Tasks & responsibilities

- Manage an in vitro pharmacology lab and mentor a team of highly skilled lab scientists, fostering a collaborative environment and actively developing the skills of your team members.
- Apply innovative in vitro and ex vivo models that reflect human liver disease conditions to identify promising drug candidates.
- Build the evidence base to translate therapeutic concepts from preclinical models to patients, leveraging experimental models and data science tools.
- Navigate effectively within a matrix-based environment, collaborating across disciplines including Medicinal Chemistry, Biologics Development, Drug Discovery Support functions, Computational Innovation, and Experimental Medicine.
- Enable decision making by communicating complex results efficiently to stakeholders.
- Maintain a strong external network, manage external collaborations, and contribute to advancing the science of liver cirrhosis by publishing papers and presenting at scientific conferences

Requirements

- Doctorate (PhD) in biology, biochemistry, or molecular pharmacology, with expert knowledge in liver physiology specifically the pathophysiology of cirrhosis complications. Knowledge of alcohol-associated liver cirrhosis is a plus.
- Multiple years of drug discovery experience in a pharmaceutical industry setting, with demonstrated expertise spanning target identification through to candidate selection. Proficiency in cell-based methods (primary cells, organotypic cultures) to model liver disease conditions in vitro/ex vivo. Skilled in molecular, cellular and biochemical profiling techniques.
- Proven line-management and leadership skills, including setting and evaluating objectives and advancing the development of team members.
- Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary project team.
- Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, combined with agile working, innovative thinking, and a problem-solving mindset.
Fluent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is a plus.
Start date: ASAP
As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.
